candidate_gate.definition: at least 5 distinct nest-count years spanning at least 10 years

stricter_gate.definition: at least 10 distinct nest-count years spanning at least 20 years

audit_outputs: candidate and stricter units by APBP region
candidate and stricter units by CCAMLR unit
fraction of candidate units in the largest one and three regions
candidate-site fraction among all APBP sites in each region

interpretation_rules.broad_coverage_flag: candidate units occupy at least 5 APBP regions and at least 3 CCAMLR units
interpretation_rules.strong_regional_concentration_flag: the largest APBP region contains more than 50% of candidate site-species units
interpretation_rules.paper_language: Use 'Antarctic-wide' only as a study-domain description, never as a claim of spatially balanced sampling. If strong regional concentration is flagged, explicitly describe the comparison as geographically uneven.

outcome_blind_boundary: do not inspect population trend direction
do not alter the temporal eligibility gate after seeing geography
do not drop regions because of anticipated effect direction
